about_the_game:
Dear gamer

This is a fast-paced MOBA game for people who don't have a long time to play standard MOBA games (LOL, Dota 2, etc.). In each game, you will play with 4 bot players to defeat another 5 bot players on the enemy team.

You can choose independent skins, skills, and items as you wish. Currently, we have up to 15 skins, 11 skills, and 52 items. These numbers will increase over time.

Specifically, we have 8 three types of monsters in the jungle waiting for you to beat. Note that these monsters will increase in strength over time.

When you die, you may have a chance to drop your bought item (50%), and you will lose 25% of your current gold.

Each game lasts an average of 8 minutes, suitable for a short break for hard workers.

I'm a solo developer who lives in the countryside with a small family with one kid. I have a great love for game development. I hope you guys enjoy the game and give feedback for better updates of this game.

Thanks a lot!
